highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
highlights_body: It ports more math to managed C# for a performance boost, fixes several native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs, adds async pixel readback and Vulkan via Silk.NET, and switches all solutions to the .slnx format.

bullets.detail: Bundles Chrome milestone m152 along with follow-up upstream m151/m152 bug-fix merges.
Adds bindings for the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving consumers an early path to Skia's next-generation renderer.
Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous pixel reads that work across GPU backends.

bullets.lead: Vulkan via Silk.NET and containerized test coverage
bullets.detail: Ships the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux, plus new containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and FreeType-based font support on Nano Server.

Fixes native use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the owning object, and fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create's raster failure path.

Caches a HandleDictionary reflection check, optimizes SKData.SaveTo to skip a double buffer copy, avoids an intermediate string allocation in encoded-text reads, and pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map.

bullets.lead: Deterministic binding generation and Windows SDK flexibility
bullets.detail: Makes binding generation deterministic across build platforms, converts all .sln solutions to .slnx, initializes the MSVC environment once per native build, and stops pinning a default Windows SDK version.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initialized the MSVC build environment once per native build on Windows
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz binding alongside the .slnx solution conversion and the new containerized test infrastructure.
